assets.prompt: Three freshly cut timber logs stacked in a small pyramid, pale cut ends with visible tree rings, brown bark.
Two roughly squared grey stone blocks, one resting on the other, with chisel marks and a few chips.
A small cluster of ripe bilberries (deep blue-purple) with two green leaves on a short sprig.
A neat stack of three sawn wooden planks, light honey-coloured wood grain, tied with a twine strap.
Two simple friendly villager figures side by side, an adult and a child, wearing rustic tunics and little pointed hoods, faces kept very simple.
A woodcutter's axe embedded in a chopping stump, with a couple of wood chips.
A woven wicker basket overflowing with bilberries.
An iron pickaxe leaning against a rough grey boulder.
A young green sapling growing from a small mound of dark soil, with a little wooden trowel beside it.
A small round thatched roundhouse with wattle walls, a dark doorway and a wisp of chimney smoke.
A two-handled pit saw resting across a log on wooden trestles.
A small timber storehouse barn on stone footings with a thatched roof and big wooden doors.
A rolled parchment scroll, partly open, tied with a red ribbon.
A wooden mallet crossed with a small iron hammer.

Game logo wordmark that reads exactly "FirstFolk" in one line. Chunky hand-carved wooden lettering with warm golden-honey highlights and a dark brown outline, slightly playful storybook serif letterforms. A small thatched roundhouse sits on top of the letter F, a sprig of green leaves curls from the final k, and a few bilberries decorate the base. Centred, isolated on a fully transparent background, no other text.

A family with a covered wooden wagon pulled by an ox arrives at dawn at the edge of a lush green river valley, distant low hills, pine and oak woods, morning mist over a winding river, a few birds in a peach and pale-blue sky. Wide landscape composition with space at the bottom centre.
Seamless tileable texture of soft cream parchment paper with very subtle fibres and faint warm mottling, evenly lit, flat, no stains near edges, no text.
